g.text: Rare vital-tissue cell expression (at least 1% in a named Vital population in the existing brain/spinal-cord/heart/lung panel) is the only Unsafe evidence for 121 proteins.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #536675

g.text: Reproductive includes placental and embryonic/fetal contexts. Unresolved proteins pass no CTA gate but are not Unsafe; Other:Held is the subset passing every target gate.
